name: board
description: Projects an ossify project's lifecycle (.ossify/project-state.json) onto a self-hosted Huly board: releases become milestones, spines issues, work items sub-issues, spine_dag blocked-by relations. Huly is a regenerable mirror, never the source of truth. A digest-gated Stop hook syncs after any session that changed the state file; /board:sync forces a full reconcile; /board:doctor reports drift, unowned issues and what the next sync would overwrite. Requires HULY_URL, HULY_WORKSPACE, HULY_TOKEN in the harness environment and a one-time 'Ossify project' space type in the workspace.
